_about: What the web site and the web flasher show for this radio (docs/dev/website.md). Hardware facts stay in docs/spec.
name: TYT MD-380
bands: 400-480 MHz or 136-174 MHz (one band per radio)

bootloader: Turn the radio off and connect the programming cable.
Hold PTT and the side key just above it.
Turn the radio on while you hold both keys. The LED blinks; the screen stays dark.
